hero.title: Send contracts, capture consent, review the completed record
hero.subtitle: Email-link signing with frozen contract terms, typed-name adoption and completion evidence built for review.
hero.caption: An illustrative workspace shows a mill certificate sent for signing, adopted by name and completed with an evidence record. Synthetic values demonstrate the flow.

trust.summary: Email-link signing, captured consent and private completion records. Hosting, delivery and assurance scope require acceptance for the selected installation.

features.bentoTitle: Completed documents and recorded signing evidence
features.bentoSubtitle: Frozen terms, recipient-bound values and captured consent accompany a completed PDF and a separate completion record.
features.sendAndSignDesc: Multi-signer envelopes with routing order, carbon copies and reminders. Signers never need an account.
features.certsAndSealingDesc: Download a completed document and a separate completion record containing captured signer values and frozen terms.
features.timestampsDesc: Signing events and completion evidence record application times. Independent trusted timestamping is outside this release.

pricing.title: Predictable pricing with no envelope surprise bills
pricing.subtitle: Choose a plan for your team size and sending volume; confirm provider integrations and assurance scope before launch.
pricing.soloBlurb: One seat and 30 envelopes per month.
pricing.starterBlurb: Three seats and 100 envelopes per month.
pricing.smartBlurb: For teams signing at volume with their own domain and API.
pricing.businessBlurb: For departments and multi-team operations at scale.
pricing.rollover: Unused envelopes roll over on renewal

compliance.title: Review the supported signing scope
